label: About
title: About The Horse Comes Apart Gently
short_blurb: A daily generated front page where the image is the interface.
body: Daily Frontpage is a daily generated interactive front page. Each edition starts from a saved source, becomes a new image-led scene, and stays explorable in the archive. The image is the interface: a visible mark in the scene opens the real source that shaped the day.

This edition began with one saved post, @DlSPUTED: Stanislav Balko, Sculptor and his Model, 1985.. Its image from pbs.twimg.com set the palette, contrast, edge behavior, and gesture. The scene became The Horse Comes Apart Gently: Flat tempera dreamscape on deep bottle-green canvas: a pale linen-beige horse lies sliced into loose slabs drifting left to right across a long maroon plank, gaps widening between segments, pencil seam lines and tiny bore-holes visible. Wide frontal plate, horizontal recline archetype, low crop pressing the plank ag... After the image was made, a plate-reading pass mapped the source to Central sliced flank slab with pencil seams and drilled dots.

typography.rationale: Bricolage Grotesque and Space Grotesk fit record, arcade, and listening-room editions while Fraunces keeps source captions tactile.
